allocations.rationale: Directly extracts exact patient-level numerators, denominators, and HPO terms across Marafi et al. and Willim et al. cohorts to answer the primary phenotypic frequency requirement.
Directly resolves discriminating features separating LRRC7 from other postsynaptic density synaptopathies like SHANK3 and SYNGAP1, evaluating the true role of seizures, hypotonia, and hyperphagia.
